integrity: An exact rational checker is supplied for formula verification, with universal conclusions proved analytically. The original physically equivalent linear update is acknowledged prior; the assessed result concerns the sharp all-convex stage-entropy-flux classification.
scientific_limitations: Exact-integration uncorrected degree-one compact RKDG for constant positive-speed scalar advection on uniform periodic meshes; two-stage order-two explicit RK with nonnegative output weights and stage-averaged upwind entropy flux. Does not assert full-polynomial stability, nonlinear or high-order generalization, or entitlement to an unrestricted CFL for a prescribed individual entropy. Independent validation not performed.
title: Midpoint rigidity for universal weak entropy stability of compact Runge–Kutta DG
